description: Marked cycle paths (MCP) registered by Brussels Mobility is a dataset listed in Open Data | Ville de Bruxelles - Stad Brussel - City of Brussels, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Bruxelles/Data Management. Marked cycle paths (MCP) registered by Brussels Mobility The marked cycle path (MCP) is delimited by two broken white lines on the ground. It is not part of the roadway: cars cannot park, stop or drive on it (except for manoeuvres). More info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are bicycle, cycling, cycle path, mobility, soft mobility, active mobility. The portal shows 2,138 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
